title: Export notes to PDF
text: You can export any note or notebook to PDF. Open the note, click the Share menu and choose Export as PDF. Images and tables are kept. Exporting a whole notebook creates one PDF with a table of contents. PDF export is available on all plans, including Free.

title: Export notes to Markdown
text: To export a note as Markdown, open Share and choose Export as Markdown. Attachments are saved in a folder next to the .md file. Bulk Markdown export of every notebook is available on Pro and Team plans from Settings > Data.

title: Using Lumen Notes offline
text: The desktop and mobile apps work offline. Notes you open are cached on your device, and edits made offline are synced automatically when you reconnect. To make a whole notebook available offline, right-click it and enable Keep offline. The web app requires an internet connection.

title: Resolving sync conflicts
text: A sync conflict happens when the same note is edited on two devices before they sync. Lumen Notes keeps both versions: the newest stays in place and the other is saved as a copy named 'Conflicted copy' with the device name and date. Compare the two and delete the one you don't need.

title: Version history
text: Lumen Notes saves a version of a note every time you stop editing for 30 seconds. Open the note, click the clock icon and pick a version to preview or restore it. Free plans keep 7 days of history, Pro keeps 1 year and Team keeps unlimited history.

title: Recovering deleted notes
text: Deleted notes go to the Trash and stay there for 30 days. To recover one, open Trash in the sidebar, select the note and click Restore. After 30 days notes are permanently deleted and cannot be recovered, even by support.

title: Plans and pricing
text: Lumen Notes has three plans. Free: up to 3 devices and 100 MB of uploads per month. Pro: $6 per month billed yearly or $8 monthly, unlimited devices and 10 GB uploads. Team: $10 per user per month with shared notebooks, admin controls and SSO.

title: Cancel your subscription
text: You can cancel at any time from Settings > Billing > Cancel plan. You keep paid features until the end of the current billing period, then the account moves to the Free plan. Your notes are never deleted when you cancel.

title: Refund policy
text: Yearly Pro and Team subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Monthly subscriptions are not refunded, but you can cancel to stop the next charge. Request a refund through the Help Center contact form.

title: Student and education discount
text: Students and teachers get 50% off Pro. Verify your status with a school email address under Settings > Billing > Education discount. Verification must be renewed every 12 months.

title: Device limit on the Free plan
text: The Free plan can be used on up to 3 devices. If you sign in on a fourth device you will be asked to sign out of another one first. Manage devices under Settings > Account > Devices. Pro and Team have no device limit.

title: Two-factor authentication
text: Turn on two-factor authentication (2FA) in Settings > Security. Lumen Notes supports authenticator apps and hardware security keys. Save your backup codes; if you lose your 2FA device and your backup codes, support must verify your identity before access is restored, which can take up to 5 business days.

title: Reset your password
text: Click 'Forgot password' on the sign-in screen and enter your account email. The reset link is valid for 1 hour. If you don't receive it, check your spam folder or request a new link after 5 minutes.

title: How your notes are encrypted
text: Notes are encrypted in transit with TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256. Pro and Team users can also lock individual notes with a separate password; locked notes are end-to-end encrypted and Lumen staff cannot read them. If you forget a note password, that note cannot be recovered.

title: Sharing notebooks with others
text: Team plans can share notebooks with workspace members as Viewer, Commenter or Editor. Pro users can share a single note with a public read-only link. Public links can be disabled at any time from the Share menu.

title: Web clipper browser extension
text: The Lumen web clipper saves articles, screenshots or whole pages into a notebook. It is available for Chrome, Firefox, Edge and Safari. After installing, sign in from the extension icon and choose a default notebook.

title: Using note templates
text: Templates give new notes a ready-made structure, such as meeting notes or a weekly review. Create a note from a template with New > From template. Save any note as your own template from the ... menu > Save as template.

title: Tags and search
text: Add tags by typing # followed by a word inside a note. Search supports quoted phrases, tag:name filters and created:2024 style date filters. Pro and Team plans also search text inside images and PDF attachments.

title: AI summaries
text: Pro and Team plans include AI summaries. Select Summarize in the toolbar to get a short summary of a long note. Summaries are generated on demand and never used to train AI models. Workspace admins on Team can turn the feature off for everyone.

title: Import from other apps
text: Import notes from Evernote (.enex files), Notion (Markdown export), or plain Markdown and text files using Settings > Data > Import. Tags and creation dates are preserved where the source app provides them.

title: Attachment size and storage limits
text: A single attachment can be up to 25 MB on Free and 200 MB on Pro and Team. Monthly upload limits are 100 MB on Free and 10 GB on Pro. Team workspaces get 20 GB per user, pooled across the workspace.

title: Delete your account
text: To permanently delete your account and all notes, go to Settings > Account > Delete account and confirm with your password. Deletion is processed within 30 days. Export your notes first; deleted data cannot be restored.

title: Keyboard shortcuts
text: Common shortcuts: Cmd/Ctrl+N new note, Cmd/Ctrl+K quick switcher, Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+F search all notes, Cmd/Ctrl+/ show every shortcut. Shortcuts can be customised in Settings > Keyboard.

title: Where your data is stored
text: By default, data is stored in data centers in the United States. Team workspaces can choose EU data residency when the workspace is created; it cannot be changed afterwards.
